_description: Office worker — balanced speed and precision, everyday desktop use

_tuning_notes.desired_speed: Base speed (m/s). Modulated by clearance and curvature rate.
_tuning_notes.speed_alpha: Speed scales as (c/speed_ref)^alpha. 0.65 calibrated to human width ratio.
_tuning_notes.speed_reference: 0.02: Fixed reference clearance (m). Wide tunnel half-width.
_tuning_notes.rate_percentile: 60: Only top 40% of curvature rates trigger slowdown (path-adaptive).
_tuning_notes.rate_scale: 3e6: Controls how quickly speed drops above threshold (higher = gentler). Scale relative to curvature rate excess (corners ~1e5–1e8).
_tuning_notes.rate_floor: 0.2: Minimum speed fraction at extreme corners (20% = strong stop-and-go).
_tuning_notes.rate_median_max: 600: Disable rate effect if median rate > this (filters out sigmoidal paths).
_tuning_notes.straight_boost: 1.5: Speed boost on straight segments (rf = 1 + boost × straightness^sharpness).
_tuning_notes.boost_sharpness: 3.0: Nonlinear selectivity. Higher = only very straight segments get boosted.
_tuning_notes.rate_ceil: 2.5: Maximum rate factor. Caps the boost on perfectly straight segments.
_tuning_notes.w_suppress: 0.1: Suppress cutting in sharp turns (lower = more cutting at corners).
_tuning_notes.cut_window_frac: 0.05: Lookahead window as fraction of path length.
_tuning_notes.global_clearance_ref: 0.025: Reference clearance for absolute task scaling. Wide task=more cut.
